entities.summary: Mukhamet Hadisovich Kharrasov (Bashkir: Мөхәмәт Хәдис улы Харрасов; Russian: Мухамет Хадисович Харрасов; 18 September 1948 – 9 March 2024) was a Russian physicist, member of the Academy of Sciences of Bashkortostan (2002), Doctor of Physical and Mathematical Sciences (1995), Professor (1996), rector of the Bashkir State University (2000–2010), honored worker of Science Russia (2008) and Bashkortostan (1997), Honored Scientist of the Russian Federation (2008), Honorary Worker of Higher Professional Education of Russia (2002), Excellence in Ministry of Education (2003).
